finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: If the number of bytes received exceeds 1024, it will overflow the buffer.
finding.assumptions: The buffer size is fixed at 1024 bytes, and the recv function does not perform bounds checking.

parsed.refutation_attempt: The recv call uses sizeof(buffer) as the length argument, which is a compile‑time constant equal to 1024. The POSIX recv function guarantees it will write at most the specified number of bytes, so it cannot overflow the 1024‑byte array. No additional checks are required for this reason.
